description: Erection of a front and rear roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition; excavation of the front garden and part of the rear garden to form lightwells, in connection with the creation of a new basement; and replacement of all existing windows with double-glazed timber windows.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
